title.en: Anthropic releases Claude 3.5 Sonnet, setting a new standard for coding AI
title.zhHans: Anthropic 发布 Claude 3.5 Sonnet，为编程 AI 设立新标准

summary.en: On June 20, 2024, Anthropic released Claude 3.5 Sonnet, which significantly outperformed GPT-4o on coding benchmarks and became the go-to model for software development. It introduced Artifacts — a built-in canvas for viewing and editing code and documents in real time alongside the conversation. Claude 3.5 Sonnet's coding ability, combined with its safety-focused design, made it the preferred model for many developers and established Anthropic as a serious competitor to OpenAI.
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 6 月 20 日，Anthropic 发布了 Claude 3.5 Sonnet，它在编程基准上显著超越 GPT-4o，成为软件开发的推荐模型。它引入了 Artifacts——一个内建画布，可以在对话同时实时查看和编辑代码与文档。Claude 3.5 Sonnet 的编程能力，结合其以安全为导向的设计，使其成为许多开发者的首选模型，并确立了 Anthropic 作为 OpenAI 的认真竞争对手的地位。

narrative.en: Claude 3.5 Sonnet arrived at a moment when the LLM landscape was consolidating around two dominant proprietary players — OpenAI and Anthropic — and a growing open-weight ecosystem. Anthropic had established itself with Claude 3 (March 2024), but Claude 3.5 Sonnet was the model that changed perceptions. It scored 92% on the HumanEval coding benchmark and set new records across a range of coding and reasoning tasks. The Artifacts feature was a genuine product innovation — instead of generating code in a text bubble, Claude could create a separate, editable workspace alongside the chat, making it feel like a collaborative development environment rather than just a chat. Anthropic also emphasized safety as a differentiator, positioning Claude 3.5 Sonnet as the most trustworthy frontier model. The release triggered a direct response from OpenAI, which accelerated GPT-4o improvements. Claude 3.5 Sonnet was shortly followed by Claude 3.5 Haiku (October 2024, fastest in its class) and Claude 3 Opus (the original heavy model), but Sonnet remained the most popular. Although Claude 3.5 Sonnet's reign as the top coding model was eventually challenged by OpenAI's o1 reasoning model (September 2024) and Google's Gemini 2.0 (December 2024), it represented a significant moment: the first time an Anthropic model was widely considered the best-in-class for a major capability area, breaking OpenAI's perceived dominance.
narrative.zhHans: Claude 3.5 Sonnet 出现在 LLM 格局围绕两个主导专有玩家——OpenAI 和 Anthropic——以及日益壮大的开源权重新生态巩固的时刻。Anthropic 已经通过 Claude 3（2024 年 3 月）确立了自己的地位，但 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 是改变认知的那个模型。它在 HumanEval 编程基准上获得了 92% 的分数，并在各类编程和推理任务中刷新了记录。Artifacts 功能是一个真正的产品创新——Claude 不是在文本气泡中生成代码，而是可以在对话旁边创建一个独立的、可编辑的工作区，使其感觉像一个协作开发环境而不仅仅是一个聊天。Anthropic 还强调安全性作为差异化因素，将 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 定位为最值得信赖的前沿模型。这次发布引发了 OpenAI 的直接回应，加速了 GPT-4o 的改进。Claude 3.5 Sonnet 之后不久发布了 Claude 3.5 Haiku（2024 年 10 月，同类最快）和 Claude 3 Opus（原始重型模型），但 Sonnet 仍然是最受欢迎的。虽然 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 作为顶级编程模型的地位最终受到 OpenAI 的 o1 推理模型（2024 年 9 月）和 Google 的 Gemini 2.0（2024 年 12 月）的挑战，但它代表了一个重要时刻：Anthropic 的模型首次被广泛认为在主要能力领域达到了最佳水平，打破了 OpenAI 感知上的主导地位。

description.en: Achieved 92% on HumanEval coding benchmark, surpassing GPT-4o and setting a new standard for AI-assisted programming. The Artifacts feature introduced a new interaction paradigm — an editable workspace alongside chat — that was widely copied by competitors.
description.zhHans: 在 HumanEval 编程基准上达到 92%，超越 GPT-4o 并为 AI 辅助编程设定了新标准。Artifacts 功能引入了一种新的交互范式——聊天旁的可编辑工作区——被竞争对手广泛借鉴。

description.en: Established Anthropic as a viable third pillar alongside OpenAI and Google in the frontier AI market. The competitive pressure accelerated model improvements and pricing reductions across the entire LLM industry.
description.zhHans: 确立了 Anthropic 作为前沿 AI 市场中与 OpenAI 和 Google 并列的第三极。竞争压力加速了整个 LLM 行业的模型改进和降价。

text.en: Anthropic released Claude 3.5 Sonnet on June 20, 2024, achieving 92% on HumanEval coding and introducing the Artifacts collaborative workspace.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 于 2024 年 6 月 20 日发布 Claude 3.5 Sonnet，在 HumanEval 编程上达到 92%，并引入了 Artifacts 协作工作区。

sources.quote: Claude 3.5 Sonnet raises the industry bar for intelligence, outperforming competitor models and Claude 3 Opus on a wide range of evaluations.
Claude is a family of large language models developed by Anthropic. Claude 3.5 Sonnet was released June 20, 2024.
